MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

2. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 40.5

3. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 4
   D. 5

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 22
   C. 44
   D. 30

6. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 77
   C. 22
   D. 18

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

9. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 2/3

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

12. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.025

13. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

15. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

16. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

17. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

18. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

19. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

20. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

21. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 30
   C. 19
   D. 60

23. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

24. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
